text:
Carlos (Customer): Hey team — running into a weird tool-call failure across our clients. We call the PDF-extract tool with a `file` arg containing raw bytes. Python/TS/Go SDKs all sometimes produce `400 schema_validation_error: tool.args.file: length mismatch` when the file contains a trailing 0x00 byte. Minimal repro below, happens on v1.4.2 of SDKs.

Sam (Support): thanks, can you paste the raw request body (strip api key) and a request-id if you have one? Also which model/route and whether you're calling via Hosted or Dedicated?

Carlos (Customer): request-id: req_0a9f3c2e. Hosted, /v1/chat/completions func call. Python repro (short):
```python
from redwood import Client
import base64

c = Client("REDACTED")
raw = b"PDFHEADER...\x00"
resp = c.chat.create(
  model="redwood-tool-1",
  messages=[{"role":"user","content":"extract"}],
  function_calls=[{"name":"pdf_extract","arguments":{"file": base64.b64encode(raw).decode()}}]
)
print(resp.error)
```
Returns 400 with schema error.

infra-bot: [automated] req=req_0a9f3c2e status=400 code=schema_validation tool.args.file: expected length 1024 got 1023

Jing (SDK): hmm — that error and the trailing 0x00 smell like a string->[]byte conversion issue. In Go if someone does `string(b)` and then `json.Marshal` you can lose bytes after a `\x00` when interfacing with C or syscall paths. But standard `encoding/json` marshals `[]byte` to base64 fine. Can you share the exact base64 payload (first/last 32 chars) and the SDK version per language?

Carlos (Customer): base64 start: "UEZERkV..." end: "...AA==" (the base64 ends with `AA==` which decodes to 0x00). Python and TS both show the `AA==` at the end. Go client 1.4.2 prints the base64 w/o padding in logs sometimes (e.g., trailing `=` gone).

Anya (Eng): quick triage thought: two likely culprits — 1) an SDK or app-layer is converting `[]byte` -> string and truncating at `\x00` because a C-based helper was used (rare but possible), or 2) a transport or proxy is interpreting the arg as C-string and trimming. Can you run a curl directly to isolate SDK? Example curl: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-tool-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"x"}],"function_calls":[{"name":"pdf_extract","arguments":{"file":"UEZERkV...AA=="}}]}'
```
If curl also fails, it's a server-side/ingress issue.

Carlos (Customer): ran curl, still 400 with same request-id req_0a9f3c2e-2. I inspected raw bytes on the server side: after server base64 decode the payload is missing the final 0x00. So something is stripping it between client and server (or the base64 was altered).

Jing (SDK): thanks — that rules out SDK-only encoding in the client process. Two more quick checks: 1) capture the outgoing wire payload bytes (tcpdump/wireshark) to see if base64 on-the-wire has padding characters. 2) check any proxy/nginx/lb with `proxy_buffering` or `proxy_set_header` that might rewrite trailing `=` characters (some ingress proxies have trouble with trailing equals in querystrings, though JSON bodies should be safe).

Devex: common gotcha we've seen — some HTTP frameworks or middleware that treat `application/json` bodies but run through an intermediate `string` sanitizer can trim NULs or strip `=` at the end if they erroneously treat content as form-encoded. Also some old CDNs will mangle bodies with body-transform rules.

Sam (Support): I'm escalating to Eng / Infra. @Anya can you get ingress logs for req_0a9f3c2e-2 and check whether the body size changed between edge and app? Add lb/request_id headers.

Anya (Eng): on it. Quick note for SDKs: Jing, can we add a test that checks base64 with trailing `AA==` payloads and ensures the server decodes to same byte length? If we verify at the SDK integration runner we can catch this in CI.

Jing (SDK): yes — I'll add an integration and a small fuzz test for embedded NUL bytes in function-call base64 fields. I'll also audit places where we do `string(b)` conversions in TS/Go helper code. Suspect spot: TS wrapper had `const s = buf.toString()` in an earlier helper (should be `buf.toString('base64')`).

infra-bot: [automated] action=attach-logs req=req_0a9f3c2e-2 logs=/var/log/edge/2026-04-02/edge-req_0a9f3c2e-2.log

Carlos (Customer): appreciate the quick triage. For now we're unblocked by sending gzipped/base64 without trailing NULs, but this will break binary formats that legitimately end with 0x00. Please keep me posted.

Jing (SDK): will follow up with a hotfix branch. Plan: 1) audit code paths for accidental `string` conversions, 2) add unit/integration tests for trailing NULs, 3) work with Infra to confirm no body transform at edge. ETA for hotfix PR: 24h.

Sam (Support): thanks all — marking as escalated -> ENG-PRIORITY. I'll update the customer when PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
